根据已读取的材料，以下是针对微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部的详细分析。

---

## 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`press_release.txt`，财务报表表格位置）：

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（截至2026年6月30日） | FY25 Q4（截至2025年6月30日） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 |

**计算过程**：

```
同比增长率 = (39,306 - 29,878) / 29,878 × 100%
          = 9,428 / 29,878 × 100%
          = 31.55%
```

**官方披露口径**：同比增长 **32%**（按恒定汇率计算为 31%）。差异源于四舍五入及汇率影响（汇率对收入影响为 +$80 百万）。

> 出处：`press_release.txt` 中财务报表表格，以及 `transcript.txt` 位置 24808："Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

---

## 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话引用）

来源：`transcript.txt` 位置 24808–25100（Amy Hood 财报电话会管理层讲解）：

> **关于 Azure：**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

> **关于 GitHub Copilot：**
> "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value**."

> **关于企业内部服务器业务：**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts**."

> **关于毛利率：**
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by **sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand**, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

---

## 3. 事实 vs 前瞻性表述的区分

| 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|---|---|
| Azure 收入增长 43% | **已发生的事实** | 明确陈述的是本季度已实现的财务结果（"revenue grew 43%"） |
| Customer demand exceeds available capacity | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是本季度已存在的供需状态（"continues to exceed" 为当前状态） |
| Efficiency gains across CPU/GPU fleet | **已发生的事实** | 是已实现的运营效率提升，直接贡献了本季度超预期增长 |
| Process improvements enabling earlier capacity delivery | **已发生的事实** | 已落地并在本季度产生效果的流程改进 |
| 新增产能当季即被快速货币化 | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" — 已完成的商业转化 |
| GitHub Copilot 商业模式变更（6月） | **已发生的事实** | "the June business model change" 是已完成的动作 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费强于预期 | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是已实现的消费表现 |
| 企业内部服务器续约的当期收入确认占比高 | **已发生的事实** | 已完成的合同续约结果 |
| AI infrastructure continued scaling | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是正在进行的投资扩张（进行时态） |
| "Results were ahead of expectations"（Azure/服务器/Copilot） | **已发生的事实** | 是与本季度指导目标的比较，属于事后回顾 |
| H1 FY27 Azure 增长将加速 | **前瞻性表述** | 出处：`transcript.txt` 位置 32535："we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" — 明确使用 "expect"，指向未来季度 |
| FY27 Q1 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95–41.25B | **前瞻性表述** | 出处：`transcript.txt` 位置 32535："we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion" — 使用 "expect"，是未来一季度的预测 |
| FY27 Q1 Azure 增长约 45%（恒定汇率） | **前瞻性表述** | 出处：`transcript.txt` 位置 32535："we expect revenue growth of approximately 45%" — 未来季度指引 |
| "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies" | **前瞻性表述** | 出处：`transcript.txt` 位置 32535 — 表达的是管理层未来的工作方向 |
| "customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **混合表述** | 前半部分描述当前事实，后半部分隐含对未来供需关系的判断（产能仍在追赶需求） |

**区分核心依据**：
- **事实**：使用过去时态或描述已实现状态（"grew", "was", "benefited from", "change to align"），可直接与本季度财务数据对应。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "expect", "will", "continue to expect", "remain focused" 等词语，指向未来季度的指引或管理层意图，不构成本季度已实现的业绩。
